decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted  shall not be carried on outside the following times: 8:00am-8:00pm Monday to Saturday and between 9.00am-2.00pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used as a Dance Studio and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 2006, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - No playing of musical instruments or operation of sound amplification equipment shall take place in any part of the premises outside of the approved operating hours (8:00am-8:00pm Monday to Saturday and between 9.00am-2.00pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays) and so as to be audible outside the premises.
description: Change of use from a carpentry workshop and ancillary offices to a dance studio and ancillary offices (D1)
